main_text.head: Ex Græco.

p.i: Pinxisti pulchra nuper Phaëtonta tabella, Altera Deucalion picta tabella tua est. Et pretio rogitas quónam sit dignus uterque? Ille quidem flammis, hic bene dignus aquis.

main_text.head: Illustriss. Principi, CHRISTOPHORO Comiti Palatino, Bavariæ Duci, &c.

p.i: Ecce tibi quale argentum Burgundia gignit, Quaque etiam salsa munera fundit aqua: Dulcis opum gustus, sale nil contra acrius uno: Integra sic hominum symbola fortis habes. Faxit at ille tua Dominus qui pocula vita Temperat, ô magni magna propago patris, Te neque dulcedo fallat, neque vexet amaror, Quin potius currat sors moderata tibi.

main_text.head: In Nouercas è Græco.

p.i: Tantem Nouerca verberans imaginem, Cecidi cadente, iacente nunc iaceo miser. Priuigne, metuas quoque nouercam mortuam.

main_text.head: AD PRISCVM in Aulicos.

p.i: Aeolus Aeolia quisnam dicatur in aula, Claudere nunc ventis, nunc referare fores Dicere

page.notes: Several words in the Greek-letter and italic lines are uncertain (e.g. "Tantem", "Dicere" line end, "vexet"); the scan is damaged at the right edge of the lines. Greek characters on the first line were not legible enough to transcribe; the Greek verse of the epigram is absent from the transcription. Possibly printing errors remain as printed.
